column1: # DISPLAY-NAME ALIASES (user idea 2026-11-19): the effect template + the spell animation stay, only the name the player reads changes, so a pet never shows a name that does not fit it.

# columns (TAB): spell name (as the fit picked it) | creature-name regex that KEEPS the original name (empty = never keep) | effect-label regex (empty = any effect) | new display name | new icon (empty = keep the spell's icon)
# first matching row wins; generated by hand from pet-battle/name_audit.tsv review
# a heal that ALSO buffs (retail heal + damage/crit rider) must not wear the name of a pure heal: the effect names the ability, the spell only lends the animation
